question: What lack of devotion disqualifies a person from receiving this teaching?
premises: A person may be devoid of devotion to the kula
A person may be deprived of devotion to the guru
Such absence of devotion is emphasized
inference: One lacking devotion to both the kula and the guru is unfit in this context.
plain_english: But in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
